claims: The 2027 Masters Tournament is scheduled for April 5–11, 2027.
The 2027 Masters Tournament is scheduled at Augusta National Golf Club.
The main tournament rounds of the 2027 Masters Tournament occur April 8–11.
The 2027 Masters Tournament rounds are Thursday, April 8 – Sunday, April 11, 2027.
Augusta National Golf Club is in Augusta, GA.
The only authorized source for 2027 Masters Tournament tickets is Augusta National, Inc.
The ticket application window for the 2027 Masters Tournament officially opens on June 1, 2026.
The ticket application window for the 2027 Masters Tournament runs through June 20, 2026.
Applications for 2027 Masters Tournament tickets are limited to one per household.
Winners of the 2027 Masters Tournament ticket lottery are selected via a random lottery.
The only official way to secure 2027 Masters Tournament tickets is via the official Masters website.
In previous years, daily Masters Tournament tickets ranged from $115 to $375.
The Augusta National Women's Amateur (ANWA) concludes on Saturday, April 3, 2027.
The Drive, Chip and Putt National Finals occur on Sunday, April 4, 2027.
The Par 3 Contest occurs on Wednesday, April 7, 2027.
